mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalMemberCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS maleCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS femaleCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN 1 END) AS age10s, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 1 END) AS age20s, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN 1 END) AS age30s, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 1 END) AS age40s, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 1 END) AS age50s, COUNT(CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(birth_date)) >= 60 THEN 1 END) AS age60sOver FROM member WHERE role != 'ADMIN' AND member_status != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulation_progress WHERE started_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01 00:00:00')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulation_progress WHERE progress_status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qna WHERE qna_status = 'WAITING'

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dateKey,
DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y') AS dateKey,
DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m') AS dateKey,
COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM simulation_progress WHERE 1=1
AND started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
AND started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
AND started_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH)
AND scenario_id = #{scenarioId}
GROUP BY dateKey ORDER BY dateKey ASC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dateKey,
DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y') AS dateKey,
DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m') AS dateKey,
COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM simulation_progress WHERE progress_status = 'COMPLETED'
AND completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
AND completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 YEAR)
AND completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH)
AND scenario_id = #{scenarioId}
GROUP BY dateKey ORDER BY dateKey ASC

SELECT s.scenario_title AS scenarioTitle, COUNT(sp.progress_id) AS startCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.progress_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeCount FROM scenario s LEFT JOIN simulation_progress sp ON s.scenario_id = sp.scenario_id AND sp.started_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY s.scenario_id, s.scenario_title ORDER BY startCount DESC, s.scenario_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.log_id AS logId, CASE WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'MEMBER' THEN 'member' WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'SCENARIO' THEN 'scenario' WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'QNA' THEN 'inquiry' ELSE LOWER(l.log_type) END AS logType, l.action_type AS actionType, CASE WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'MEMBER' THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(m_target.member_name, '회원'), ' 회원 상태를 변경했습니다.') WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'SCENARIO' THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(s.scenario_title, '시나리오'), ' 시나리오를 수정했습니다.') WHEN UPPER(l.log_type) = 'QNA' THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(m_qna.member_name, '회원'), ' 회원 문의에 답변했습니다.') ELSE '운영자 작업을 수행했습니다.' END AS title, IFNULL(m_admin.login_id, 'admin') AS operatorId, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_log l LEFT JOIN member m_admin ON l.admin_id = m_admin.member_id LEFT JOIN admin_log_member alm ON l.log_id = alm.log_id LEFT JOIN member m_target ON alm.member_id = m_target.member_id LEFT JOIN admin_log_scenario als ON l.log_id = als.log_id LEFT JOIN scenario s ON als.scenario_id = s.scenario_id LEFT JOIN admin_log_qna alq ON l.log_id = alq.log_id LEFT JOIN qna q ON alq.qna_id = q.qna_id LEFT JOIN member m_qna ON q.member_id = m_qna.member_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (admin_id, log_type, action_type, created_at) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{logType}, #{actionType}, NOW())
